title: The Sculptural Series
subtitle: Sculptural Forms
description: Objects defined by fluid transitions and organic geometry. Each piece is hand-carved from solid walnut, blurring the line between utility and fine art.
detailDescription: A curation of silhouettes that challenge the boundary between functional utility and pure artistic form. Crafted from raw walnut and hand-finished bronze.

title: Architectural Monoliths
subtitle: Architectural Monoliths
description: Inspired by brutalist structural integrity. Materials like cast concrete and raw travertine are refined into silhouettes of absolute permanence.
detailDescription: A collection of weight, silence, and architectural discipline.

title: Modern Heritage
subtitle: Modern Heritage
description: A bridge between ancestral craftsmanship and digital-age precision. We revisit classical proportions through a lens of ultra-minimalist discipline.
detailDescription: Traditional craft, digitally refined for the modern domestic landscape.
